text: He knocked on the door in the dark, and the first thing he said was this: Teacher, we know you have come from God, because no one could do what you do unless God were with him.
Bible students notice one small word there — we.
Nicodemus had been talking with other rulers, quietly, behind closed doors.
Some of the very men who opposed Jesus in public already believed it in private.
He just couldn't say it in daylight.
